ValidationRule.description: Prevents invalid Order status transitions. Blocks any change once the Order is in a terminal state (Delivered or Cancelled). Also blocks backwards transitions that violate the defined lifecycle.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status__c) && ( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Delivered") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Cancelled") || (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Accepted") && ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending")) || (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Preparing") && (ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending") || ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Accepted"))) || (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Out for Delivery") && (ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending") || ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Accepted") || ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Preparing"))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid status transition. Terminal statuses (Delivered, Cancelled) cannot be changed. Lifecycle order: Pending - Accepted - Preparing - Out for Delivery - Delivered.
